newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: National Australia Bank names new Irish chief.
newsitem.headline: National Australia Bank names new Irish chief.

text.p: National Australia Bank Ltd has appointed Grahame Savage as chief executive of its Irish operations, National Irish Bank in the Irish Republic and Northern Bank in Northern Ireland.
Savage, who is currently general manager retail financial services for NAB, succeeds John Wright who has been named head of the Gulf Bank in Kuwait, NIB said in a statement on Thursday.
NAB said its UK and Irish operations were currently achieving good results and looked set to benefit from improved economic conditions.

"We have begun a concerted effort to ensure our activities in the United Kingdom and Ireland are well positioned to take advantage of improved economic prospects there," NAB managing director Don Argus said.
